messages:
maya: Quick preflight — weights path for phoenix-rv2?

jordan: It's under gs://redwood-models/phoenix/rv2/2026-02-01/weights.tar.gz
Please use the symlink gs://redwood-models/phoenix/rv2/latest for CI.

leo: Heads-up: tokenizer has a weird non-breaking-space token in training vocab -> splits sentences odd.
Run `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --model phoenix-rv2` before serving.

anika: Golden-output regression: structured tool-call JSON is getting an extra null field. Example:
```
{"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "x"}, "result": null}
```
Should be omitted entirely when empty.

sam: Are we running the tool-calling smoke in staging? pinging @ci-bot for the job name.

ci-bot: pipeline phoenix-onboard-preflight (checks: weights-validation, tokenizer-lint, golden-eval, toolcall-smoke) started by @maya at 2026-03-16T14:02:11Z

maya: Thanks — FYI tokenizer_lint job returns 2 warnings but exit 0. Should fail on warnings? :thinking:

leo: I'd rather fail. Those two warnings are likely to cause structured output drift. I can push a tokenizer patch to drop NBSP token.

jordan: weights checksum: `sha256:9f3a...` verified locally. Note that sharded weights path changed — update config.yaml model.weights -> gs://redwood-models/phoenix/rv2/shards/

anika: golden-eval reports 3/120 diffs; 1 is the null-field issue, 1 is formatting whitespace, 1 is toolcall ordering. I'll add targeted prompts to the golden set to isolate.

sam: For toolcall ordering — we'll add deterministic sort in the toolbridge shim. Quick patch incoming.

deploy-bot: rollout-preflight lint: ✅ weights-validation
rollout-preflight lint: ⚠ tokenizer-lint (2 warnings)
rollout-preflight lint: ❌ golden-eval (3 diffs)

maya: Ok plan: leo drops tokenizer patch -> CI should then fail on lint; sam fixes toolbridge ordering; anika tightens golden prompts -> re-run pipeline. I'll tag everyone in PRs. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll update the model config and the symlink once CI green.

maya: Great. If anyone needs staging creds to run manual checks ping me. I'll update the runbook with the new validator commands.

sam: one more: add `--strict-json` flag to the generation fn to reject null fields during toolcall response generation.

anika: adding test cases to golden suite now, will push in ~30m.

maya: merge window target: tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
